power_change.scope: Target input capacitor changes for source-protected nominal 12V custom micro-HDMI candidate; CAD changes performed by parent agent.
power_change.source_contract: Upstream source current limiting and surge/ramp control are REQUIRED. Exact cable/source current limit and full-load/temperature capability remain unqualified. No hot-plug qualification is claimed.

C1.status: 12V candidate: manufacturer confirms 47uF +/-20%, 25V X5R, 1210, -55 to +85C, preferred part; effective capacitance at 12V, aging, temperature, inrush and power-entry transient performance remain unqualified. Replaces incompatible 10V input capacitor.
